offences.quote: Whilst the University does not ban the use of Gen-AI, it is possible that inappropriate or unethical use may contravene the University’s Academic Integrity Procedure and may be penalised as a result.

For assessments on programmes covered by Bangor’s Fitness to Practise Procedure, use of Gen-AI beyond that declared on the Gen-AI coversheet and/or misrepresentation of use, may represent a breach of the fitness to practice requirements for that programme.
